retainedEvidence.limitations: Exact native entry and host were matched privately; selected tenant identity, minimum roles, CSP enforcement and current response state remain unproved.

freshObjective: Current tenant-host authentication and CSP response-shape drift cannot be established from retained October evidence. One passive navigation/reload through the existing portal surface; no tenant switch, settings edit or enforcement test.

authority.userGoal: Representative fresh read-only collection; normal OS/browser sign-in for same previously selected account if needed.

authenticationRecovery: Reuse dedicated cached SharePoint profile and same unambiguous prior account; stop before consent/new permissions/tenant switching, or unavailable login/feature. Never device-code authentication.
failureRecovery: Preserve checkpoints and all failed/incomplete artifacts; no unchanged failure retry or endpoint-removal inference. Require a distinct observed remedy and newly reviewed plan before any subsequent attempt.
